title: Modular Pluralism: Pluralistic Alignment via Multi-LLM Collaboration
findings: The proposed method, MODULAR PLURALISM, improves an LLM's ability to steer its responses to align with perspectives associated with religious affiliations. In the OpinionQA task, this method achieved the highest accuracy for the religion attribute (55.9% for ChatGPT and 46.7% for Llama2-13B) compared to vanilla, prompting, and mixture-of-experts baselines.
